# Baki Bondhu (বাকী বন্ধু)
> Baki Bondhu is an offline-first, Bengali voice-enabled retail digital ledger and cash management Android application developed by DevCenterPoint for retail merchants in Bangladesh.

## Main Overview
- [Official Website & Web Hub](https://bakibondhu.devcenterpoint.com/): Official distribution hub, live interactive khata studio, feature tours, and direct Android APK download.
- [Direct Android APK Download (Latest)](https://bakibondhu.devcenterpoint.com/downloads/bakibondhu-latest.apk): Always downloads the latest production package with correct filename (`bakibondhu-v2.2.0.apk`).
- [Direct Android APK Download (v2.2.0)](https://bakibondhu.devcenterpoint.com/downloads/bakibondhu-v2.2.0.apk): Production Android package (27.3 MB, compatible with Android 7.0 Nougat to Android 16).
- [Official GitHub Repository](https://github.com/beingmushfiq/Baki-Bondhu): Source code, release tags, issue tracker, and developer contributions.

## Key Architecture & Specifications (v2.2.0)
- **Offline-First Architecture**: 100% functional without mobile internet or Wi-Fi using Room SQLite v5. Zero merchant data leakage.
- **Google Sign-In & Firebase Realtime Cloud Backup**: Seamless one-tap Google authentication with automated cloud backup on every transaction and 1-tap manual sync to protect store data across devices.
- **Archive Zone (Soft Delete & Restore)**: Deleted customers and transactions are safely moved to an archive zone with 1-tap instant restoration or permanent purge safeguards.
- **In-App GitHub Update Engine**: Directly check for official updates from GitHub Releases (`beingmushfiq/Baki-Bondhu`) and install newer APKs without leaving the app.
- **Zero Currency Rounding Drift**: Eliminates IEEE 754 floating-point drift by computing all monetary transactions in 64-bit integer paisa (১ টাকা = ১০০ পয়সা). Guarantees zero discrepancy over millions of transactions.
- **Bengali Natural Language Voice Parser**: In-app NLP engine interpreting colloquial Bangladeshi retail expressions ("দেড় হাজার", "আড়াই হাজার", "পাঁচশো", "নগদ বিক্রি", "বকেয়া আদায়").
- **Flexible 5-Tab Date Filtering**: Filter store transactions across "All Time", "Today", "This Week", "This Month", and custom date ranges with an intuitive calendar picker.
- **Saturday-Aligned Commercial Week**: Aligns reporting with Bangladeshi retail traditions where accounts open Saturday morning and balance Friday evening.
- **1-Tap WhatsApp Payment Reminders**: Auto-generates courteous Bengali payment reminders including shop name, bKash number, and Nagad number.
- **Sequential Bengali Numbering & Protected Typography**: Sequential numbering (`০১.`, `০২.`, `০৩.`) in debt recovery lists with single-line ellipsize typography.

## Technical Specifications
- **Package ID**: `com.aistudio.bakibondhu.kxdznp`
- **Current Version**: `2.2.0` (Version Code 22)
- **Minimum OS**: Android 7.0 (API Level 24)
- **Target OS**: Android 16 (API Level 36)
- **Distribution File Size**: ~27.3 MB
- **Developer & Publisher**: DevCenterPoint (https://devcenterpoint.com)
